decisions.reason: The same client decision explicitly classifies the Account Provisioning wizard as an informational non-marketing page, which the existing MODIFY omits.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:

I also want to add some informational (non-marketing) pages including the Sign In page and an Account Provisioning wizard. These only need a background plus header logo and perhaps the above footer. decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the shared background, header-logo, optional-footer, and informational-page treatment.
Optional use of the footer on sign-in and provisioning pages affects those page treatments, while the footer's independently specified content is already captured by its same-message MODIFY.
The informational-page treatment concerns sign-in and account provisioning pages, not the dashboard console shell.
The source decision does not change any required design-token category, value, asset, or state.
Using a background derived from the landing page for informational pages does not modify the landing page's own visual design.
Requiring a header logo on informational pages does not restore or otherwise change website header navigation.
The source decision does not change the implementation stack or landing-page handoff obligation.
The source decision specifies informational-page styling but establishes no responsive-layout or breakpoint change.
